payload.title: Resolvers: create, decide and suggest links
payload.description:
amplify/data/reference-link-actions.ts in the pattern of amplify/data/message-actions.ts:
- createReferenceLink(subjectLineageId, objectKind, objectLineageId, predicate) -> current, provenance human, addedBy from the caller's identity.
- decideReferenceLink(relationId, decision accept|reject, reasonCode?, note?) -> stamps decidedBy/At from identity.
- suggestReferenceLinks(referenceId) -> runs suggest_for on demand (Lambda or the procedure runner; decide which in the PR and say why).
Auth: editors of the site only. Lint with APPSYNC_JS rules and evaluate-code before release (resolver deploy lessons: no relative resolver entry).
Gherkin: features/reference-related-ui.feature backend scenarios.
Owner rules that apply: no fixed caps, day windows or magic thresholds (derive or learn them; bound only by time, cost, context size); decisions go to decision models (Jev / the site Cyclotron), the LLM (GPT-6 Luna) only writes; Gherkin specs (narrative, complete) for every behaviour change; say "idea(s)", never "draft"/"proposed story".
